description: This Java source file defines the 'Program' class within the OpenMRS project. The class models a healthcare program, including properties like workflows, concepts, and identifiers, along with methods to manipulate these properties.

classes.name: Program
classes.description: Represents a healthcare program with associated workflows and concepts. Extends BaseChangeableOpenmrsMetadata and supports adding, removing, and retrieving workflows based on various criteria.

methods.name: addWorkflow
methods.description: Adds a new ProgramWorkflow to the program and sets its parent reference.

methods.name: removeWorkflow
methods.description: Removes a specified ProgramWorkflow from the program.

methods.name: getWorkflowByName
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgramWorkflow object matching the given name, regardless of locale.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the Program object including its id, concept, and workflows.

methods.name: getConcept
methods.description: Returns the Concept associated with the program.

methods.name: setConcept
methods.description: Sets the Concept associated with the program.

methods.name: getOutcomesConcept
methods.description: Returns the Concept representing possible outcomes for this program.

methods.name: setOutcomesConcept
methods.description: Sets the Concept representing possible outcomes for this program.

methods.name: getWorkflow
methods.description: Retrieves a specific workflow by its ID.

methods.name: getAllWorkflows
methods.description: Returns all associated workflows, including retired ones.

methods.name: setAllWorkflows
methods.description: Sets the complete set of workflows.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Overrides method to return program ID, as part of OpenmrsObject interface.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Overrides method to set program ID, as part of OpenmrsObject interface.
